title: Persimmon Pet‑Friendly 3‑Bedroom Seaside Rental
meta_description: Unwind at Persimmon, a pet‑friendly 3‑bedroom Seaside vacation rental with a welcoming porch, comfortable interiors, and an easy walk to the beach and town center.
description_expanded: Prime Location with Classic Seaside CharmTucked away in a highly desirable Seaside location, Persimmon welcomes guests with warmth, comfort, and timeless coastal character. This pet-friendly vacation rental in Seaside, Florida is just a short stroll from the beach, Central Square, swimming pools, tennis courts, playground, and fitness center—making it an ideal home base for enjoying everything Seaside has to offer.Inviting Outdoor Living SpacesDesigned to embrace Seaside’s laid-back lifestyle, Persimmon offers abundant private outdoor space. A sweeping front porch sets the scene for relaxing in the coastal breeze and enjoying casual people-watching, while two levels of screened-in porches provide serene settings for al fresco dining, lounging, and entertaining. With ample seating and an outdoor grill, these spaces are perfect for long afternoons and easy evenings outdoors.Comfortable Guest Bedrooms on the First FloorThe first level of the home features two inviting queen bedrooms, each with its own private half bath and glass doors opening directly to the porch. Between the rooms, a unique rustic-style bath area includes an additional sink and a distinctive sunken shower, creating a functional and charming shared space.Open-Concept Living on the Second FloorUpstairs, the second floor opens into a bright and welcoming living area designed for gathering. The cozy living room is anchored by a flat-screen TV, while the adjacent dining area comfortably seats six. The well-appointed kitchen features stainless steel appliances and everything needed for preparing meals at home. Just off the kitchen, a second-story screened porch offers another peaceful spot for dining or relaxing.Private Primary Suite RetreatOccupying the third floor, the primary suite serves as a private retreat. This spacious bedroom features a king bed and access to its own balcony—an ideal perch for enjoying morning coffee or watching the sun set over the rooftops of Seaside.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum Winter* Pets are allowed with certain restrictions and provisions. An additional $100 per day rental pet fee will be collected, in addition to the flat $150 pet fee, for three-bedroom homes. Pets will not be allowed on furniture.*Please be advised that neighboring properties may currently be undergoing construction or renovation during your stay. As a result, intermittent noise or construction-related activity may occur at certain times throughout the day. This work is managed by third parties outside of our control, and we appreciate your understanding while enjoying the property. For additional questions or concerns regarding nearby construction activity, please contact Homeowner’s Collection at 1-855-411-1557.FEATURES1,140 square feetSeaside private residential beach access at Tupelo Pavilion3-minute walk, 176 yards to beach accessPet friendlyLocated on the east side of SeasideMultiple screened-in porchesWasher & dryerPeacock Alley linens – fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityStarter amenities provided with personalized service throughout your stayTwo parking passes for two-bedroom and larger homes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitSTR23-002398
